title: Rune Construction compositional identity/state taxonomy
authority_note: This taxonomy organizes source-grounded and owner-directed design responsibilities. It is not yet a deterministic grammar and does not invent a canonical rune vocabulary.

identity_state_layers.purpose: Identity, label, semantic intent, source/proposal status, aliases, version and provenance of the smallest reusable rune unit.
What an atom/construction means or affects, routed to existing spell/effect vocabulary without converting every spell into a rune.
Owner-directed connection type and adjacency/flow responsibilities; concrete connection grammar remains future governed design.
Shape/radius/direction/placement modifiers, informed by Scriptcraft shape/radius modification but not assumed to use source-unstated syntax.
Targeting, range, area, scope and specificity inputs; inherit only explicitly adopted core-magic constraints.
Activation conditions, delays, timing and conditional logic, grounded by Scripts/Macros.
Ordered/chained composition, conditional branches and multi-part construction, grounded by macro sequencing concepts.
Invocation channel, caster/focus/item/ritual context and links to core casting rules.
Mana/material/charge/slot/time/XP budgets as typed inputs; no automatic formula is adopted at foundation.
Resonance, instability, crafting failure, misfire, backlash and recoverable failure state.
Recognition, resistance, counterspell/disruption, dispelling, removal and defensive interaction.
Knowledge tiers, XP/perk access, training/research and unlock boundaries; source-specific prices remain source-specific.
Engraving, sigil surfaces, materials, tools, item/focus/body inscription, enchantment and charge-holder linkage while PPIA-03 keeps item ownership.
Role-safe visibility plus keyboard, screen-reader, non-color and linear/nonvisual construction representation.
Source/proposal distinction, conflict retention, expected-version/idempotent mutation and interrupted-operation recovery.

owner_design_intent.authority: governed owner intent carried in the PPIA-07 checkpoint; mechanics still require explicit design acceptance
